{{Quote|My dragon is hungry. Throw this scum in!|[[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Elder]], sentencing [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Bounty Hunter">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>}}
'''Gardulla's krayt dragon''' was a vicious canyon krayt dragon kept by [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Elder]]. She would often feed her prisoners and enemies to it in a way similar to that of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] and his [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|rancor]].

==Biography==
This [[Canyon krayt dragon/Legends|canyon krayt dragon]], owned by [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]], lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] as her "pet" for an unknown amount of time before the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] arrived in 32 BBY after receiving a tip from Jabba on her dealings with the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]].

After Jango had been captured by Gardulla's forces, he was to be fed to the beast in place of [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], who was to be sold instead. After his armor and weapons had been removed, he had been placed in the arena, alongside two [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards who were to ensure his execution. After a short speech by Gardulla, the [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] was released. However, thanks to his skill, Jango managed to escape the arena, leaving the beast to deal with the two Gamorreans instead.

After fighting his way through the rest of [[Imperial Station Bravo|Gardulla's palace]], he came face to face with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] herself inside her throne room. After speaking with her, the Hutt released the krayt dragon into the room in a last attempt to kill the bounty hunter, but did not count on Jango walking behind her and shoving her down in front of the beast, who then consumed her whole. Jango would then go on to fight the beast, ultimately killing it after a lengthy battle. But Jango Fett had killed the krayt dragon before it could fully digest her, allowing Gardulla to crawl out of its stomach and exit through its mouth and survived her encounter with the bounty hunter.
